item.title: Masego Hits the Reset Button With Soul-Baring New ‘Fix Your Face’ Album: ‘I Was Mad at God for a Little Bit’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, and today we're talking about Grammy-nominated artist Masego. He's getting ready to release his new album, Fix Your Face, and we're here to give you the inside scoop.
[Cut to interview clip]
Masego: It's like basketball – I'm focused on the next play. I'm trying to understand how people are today. I always see my music as life music; when you listen to me, you're doing some life stuff.
Host: That's Masego, talking about his approach to music. His new album, Fix Your Face, drops tomorrow, July 17th, via EQT Recordings and Capitol Records. This is his first studio album since his 2023 self-titled LP, and it's been a long time coming.
[Cut to interview clip]
Masego: Mind you, I was in Brazil at the time, and I'm watching my house burn on TV. It was surreal, and I was in disbelief... then I started to do my I don't care; I'm tough thing.
Host: Masego lost his home in the January 2025 Southern California wildfires, while he was in Brazil. He's since relocated to New York City, where he's been soaking up the city's vibrant culture.
[Cut to music clip: "Tadow" by Masego and FKJ]
Host: You might know Masego from his hit song "Tadow", which brought him from a college dropout to a go-to R&B collaborator. Now, he's back with a new album that promises to be just as soulful and seductive. We can't wait to hear it.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Fix Your Face drops tomorrow, July 17th. Make sure to check it out and follow Masego's journey. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you in the next episode.
